section.title: Project Structure Fragment
section.para: This fragment is included via XInclude from the main document. It demonstrates modular documentation practices and proper use of DocBook XInclude functionality.
The project follows a strict structure:

formalpara.title: Source Code
formalpara.para: Located in src/main/java with AGPL-3.0-only licensing.

formalpara.title: Documentation
formalpara.para: Located in src/main/docbook with CC-BY-SA-4.0 licensing.

formalpara.title: Automation Scripts
formalpara.para: Located in scripts/ for environment setup and quality gates.
